result:
PR #419 is out of draft and marked ready, on head `9536845ce5`. The device test confirmed the colour-space conversion change: the judge passed all 84 checks.

**Why the first attempt didn't finish:** it stopped, correctly, to wait for the device test. Both runs (with and without the change) did complete on the thor device, but the arms job never posted its verdict comment on the PR, so the resume saw "no verdict" (`arm=none`). I found the results under `dispatch/results/1790451286-arms-yuv10-{base,fix}` and ran `ab_compare.py` against the registered prediction myself. That is recorded in `docs/lanes/yuv10/NOTES.md`.

| capture | before | after |
|---|---:|---:|
| BumpMap_YUY2_L, BumpMap_UYVY_L, BumpEnvLum_YUY2_L, BumpEnvLum_UYVY_L | 111,496 px each | 1,576 px each (the predicted figure; the brief allowed up to 2,000) |
| TexFmt_YUY2_L, TexFmt_UYVY_L (must not move) | 0 | 0 |
| the other 80 Bump captures | — | each unchanged |

To finish off:
- **Merged origin/master.** The only conflict was the generated `docs/testing/nv2a_index.json`, which I rebuilt against the same pinned tests commit master uses (`6743b6ab16`).
- **Preflight passes** on the new head (run with `--allow-tracker`).
- **The PR's Files line matches** `git diff --stat origin/master...HEAD`, all 9 files.
- **Verdict posted** as a `[lane.yuv10]` comment on #419, since the arms job never posted one.

Each side ran once. The drop of 109,920 px on each of the four captures is far too large to be device noise, but it is still one run per side.

`pgraph.c` now goes back to lane.ring53impl.

The Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors need authorizing in claude.ai's connector settings before they can be used. Nothing in this task needed them.
